name: azure-boards-source
description: Pull tasks from Azure Boards work items, write results back

configSchema.label: Personal access token
configSchema.help: A PAT with Work Items (Read & Write) and Project and Team (Read), or {"$env":"WORCA_ADO_BOARDS_TOKEN"}. Kept separate from worca's Code token on purpose.

configSchema.label: Close work item on completion
configSchema.help: yes = move the work item to its type's Completed state when a pipeline finishes successfully
